events.title: CYPRUS SYMPHONY ORCHESTRA – THE JUNGLE BOOK  Family Concerts – 5.11.2026
events.description:
Larnaka: Thursday 5 November 2026 – Larnaka Municipal Theatre G. Lycourgos, 18:00

The Cyprus Symphony Orchestra brings to life the captivating score of The Jungle Book (1942), under the baton of the Cypriot maestro Kyriaki Kountouri. Based on five of the nine Mowgli stories from Rudyard Kipling’s classic 1894 collection of the same name, this fantasy adventure inspired one of the most iconic film scores of Hollywood’s Golden Age, composed by the eminent Hungarian-American film composer Miklós Rózsa.

Renowned for his unforgettable scores to classic films such as Ben-Hur, Spellbound, El Cid and The Thief of Bagdad, Rózsa vividly captures the adventurous spirit, imagination, heroism, humour and mystery of the jungle, masterfully blending traditional Indian musical elements with the grandeur of the symphonic idiom.

The score features eighteen distinct themes, one for each of the story’s principal characters. Through this richly imaginative, almost operatic approach, Rózsa vividly brings to life both humans and jungle animals.

Set in India, the tale unfolds through the memories of an elderly storyteller who recounts the adventures of Mowgli, a boy raised in the jungle. Driven by a desire to avenge his father’s death at the claws of the fearsome tiger Shere Khan, Mowgli embarks on a journey filled with danger, discovery and courage. Along the way, he encounters a lost city, uncovers a hidden treasure, saves his village from destruction, and ultimately chooses the freedom of the jungle he calls home.

Mezzo soprano Marilena Nisidi – recipient of an honourable mention at the recent International Masterclass & Competition for Opera Soloists organised by the Cyprus Symphony Orchestra – performs the beautiful lullaby for Mowgli.

Enhanced by live narration by Petros Georkadjis, this magical family concert promises an immersive and unforgettable journey into one of cinema’s most beloved adventures—an experience sure to delight audiences of all ages.

Miklós RÓZSA: ‘The Jungle Book’ Suite for narrator and orchestra (1942)

The thrilling film score for The Jungle Book (1942) for narrator and orchestra

by Hollywood Oscar-winning composer Miklós Rózsa!

Marilena Nissidi, mezzo soprano

Kyriaki Kountouri, conductor

events.title: Regatta of Champions – The R.O.C. (Optimist & ILCA4) – 8-15.11.2026 & 22-29.11.2026
events.description:
After several years of reviewing Optimist sailing events worldwide, the changes in sailing and the rapid transition to a technological race that has somehow relegated sailors and coaches to secondary status, Famagusta Nautical Club and the organizers of Regatta of Champions – The R.O.C. cooperated and organized for three consecutive years the pioneer for the sport of Sailing, the Championship of Champions.

Regatta of Champions – The R.O.C., is the result of a four-year effort that finally reached the implementation phase in 2022. A form of event that had never been done before, worldwide, that can be held anywhere in the world, in any country and in any category, using the sponsors and standards of the organizers. Scheduled again this year on 08 – 15 of November and using the same pattern, the top 45 Optimists from around the world are invited to The R.O.C. Applying a selection formula, based on difficulty of events, invitations are sent to the top sailors of the World Championships, as well as all Continental Championships (European, North & South America, Asia and Oceania, and Africa). At least 20% of invitations will be for the other gender. If a Continental Championship is not completed before the R.O.C., invitations are sent to eligible sailors from the same continent, the previous year.

All invitations are given, in person and/or through the National Federations and addressed to specific sailors. If the invited sailors are unable to participate in the event, then the invitation is transferred to the next ranked sailor. In addition, there are 19 Wild Cards for sailors to claim during 2025. One Wild Card will always go to the National Champion of the country or the top athlete of the Club hosting the event. 10 Wild Cards are given to the top 10 sailors of our subsidiary worldwide event, The R.O.C. Kosmos, which will be organized for 3rd consecutive year in Athens, from 03 – 10 of July, with co-organizer Nautical Club of Kalamaki, and the rest 8 Wild Cards are split into 2 sailing camps with the top 2 winners from each camp getting invitations, either through existing international races held around the world. Once the fleet is invited and formed, the 5th Championship of Champions will once again take place in Limassol, Cyprus. The event lasts a week with 5 competition days, and plenty of events.

Our pioneering spirit, however, continues and expands our Annual World Event, as this year, after intense study and global interest from athletes and coaches of the ILCA4 boat category, we are organizing, in the same vein, the 1st International Regatta of Champions – The R.O.C. ILCA 4.

This race, which will be organized from 22 – 29 November 2026, in Limassol, at our venue again, as we have mentioned, adopts the exact same pattern as the Optimist category event, with the only difference being the number of athletes, which is 40 instead of 45. The subsidiary competition The R.O.C. Kosmos, will also be organized for the ILCA4 category, on June 24th – July 1st, in Athens, which will also give the opportunity to 18 participating athletes to claim a wild card. We emphasize again that the exact same pattern is followed in both competitions.

Participating sailors and coaches are chasing the Champions Cup, but mainly an academic scholarship prize money of €33,000 which is awarded to the top 10 sailors in the form of scholarships for academic expenses and to the top 3 coaches in the form of prizes.

The participation fee covers registration, accommodation, meals and boat charter actual costs. One or two boats accommodate all coaches; however, optional coach boat charters are available, per coach.

On the official website of the event, www.regattaofchampions.com you can find all the details and rich photographic material of last year’s event, which left an excellent impression on the participants, attendants, visitors and managed to win the interest of the global sailing world, for the innovative this idea and its excellent implementation, adding value to today’s sailing events around the world. Remarkable, unique and highly effective in its aim, the promotion of the event, including all events and sailings, through the live streaming service, leaves all those interested, worldwide, with the most positive impressions.

The organizing committee of the Race is ready, with more experience now, to work even harder for even bigger thrills.

 

Regatta of Champions – The R.O.C. Optimist: 08 – 15 November 2026

Regatta of Champions – The R.O.C. ILCA4: 22 – 29 November 2026

events.title: Lefkara Classic 2026 – 12-15.11.2026
events.description:
The Lefkara Classic is a premier international endurance cycling event (Brevet-style) organized end-to-end by the team running The Agora Hotel in Pano Lefkara. The event has evolved into a full “Race Week” (November 12th–15th, 2026), offering a comprehensive four-day experience that includes social rides, professional training talks, cycling cinema screenings, and meet-and-greets with world-class cycling athletes.

The race features an incredibly demanding 150km route packing almost 5,000 meters of elevation gain, leveraging the quiet, safe tarmac and mountainous topography of the Troodos range. The route passes directly through the landmark Machairas Monastery and along the celebrated Pitsilia Wine Route, guiding riders through remote, picturesque mountain villages including Farmakas, Alona, Zoopigi, and Ayios Constantinos.

This four-day event acts as a powerful catalyst for boosting sustainable regional tourism, encouraging participants to stay for the duration of the entire program. By filling regional accommodations and supporting local businesses during the off-peak November period, the event directly revitalizes the local economy and dynamically promotes sports tourism in Lefkara and the surrounding mountain network.

events.title: CYPRUS SWIM SERIES – PISSOURI EDITION – 13-15.11.2026
events.description:
Cyprus Swim Series is an international series of competitive open water swimming. The event will take place in Pissouri (3rd edition) on the 13th to 15th of November 2026, at Pissouri Beach, just in front of Columbia Beach Resort. Cyprus Swim Series is comprised of a 8km super endurance individual race, a 8km relay race, a 5km endurance race, a 3km challenge race, a 2km fins race, a 1,25km juniors race and a 0,5km kids race. The event attracts people from all around Europe and locals. Junior races are aged from 13 to 17 years old; Kids races are aged from 8 to 12 years old; the other distances are categorized in groups like: 18-29, 30-39, 40-49 and 50+. All distances have different award ceremonies for men and women. 8km individual and relay races have no age categories. 8km relay race can be done in 2 persons of 4km each or 4 person of 2 km each. Pre race gathering is also part of the event, where lines referees and FINA referees explain the race course, talk about safety, fair play and answer questions that participants might have.

events.title: Radisson Blu Larnaka International Marathon – 15.11.2026
events.description:
The Radisson Hotels Larnaka Marathon is one of Cyprus’ leading sporting events and the official marathon of the city of Larnaka. Held annually, the event attracts thousands of runners and visitors from around the world, combining sport, tourism, culture, and the unique coastal experience of Larnaka.

The event features multiple race categories suitable for all ages and fitness levels, including the Marathon, Half Marathon, 10ΚΜ and 5ΚΜ races, a corporate race, children’s races, and family-friendly entertainment activities.

The race routes stretch along Larnaka’s stunning Mediterranean coastline and pass through some of the city’s most iconic landmarks, including Finikoudes Promenade, Saint Lazarus Church, Piale Pasa, the Larnaka Salt Lake, and the Hala Sultan Tekke Mosque, offering participants a memorable running experience by the sea.

Officially certified by AIMS, the Radisson Hotels Larnaka Marathon is renowned for its flat and fast course, ideal for achieving personal best performances. The event also places strong emphasis on sustainability, community engagement, and charitable initiatives supporting local organisations and social causes.

With more than 13,000 participants from over 80 countries, the Radisson Hotels Larnaka Marathon has established itself as an internationally recognised sports tourism event that promotes Larnaka as a vibrant and welcoming destination.

events.title: CYPRUS SYMPHONY ORCHESTRA – STARLIGHT 2 – Works by Barber and Tchaikovsky – Celebrating 20 years of Cyprus Symphony Orchestra Foundation – 19.11.2026
events.description:
Celebrating 20 years of Cyprus Symphony Orchestra Foundation

Lefkosia: Thursday 19 November 2026 – Strovolos Municipal Theatre, 20:30

The Cyprus Symphony Orchestra is honoured to welcome the superb violinist Diana Tishchenko, one of the most compelling violinists of her generation, under the baton of the Orchestra’s Artistic Director, Myron Michailidis.

Praised for her genuinely distinctive, individual voice, radiant tone and expressive depth, Diana Tishchenko is the 1st Grand Prix winner at the legendary Long-Thibaud-Crespin International Competition in Paris, and recipient of the Chevalier of the Ordre des Arts et des Lettres by the French Ministry of Culture for her outstanding contribution to the arts.

Few works capture the depth of human emotion as powerfully as this programme. Samuel Barber’s Adagio for Strings is often regarded as one of the saddest and most moving pieces ever written. Unfolding a poignant arc of swell and release, it has become an enduring symbol of collective remembrance and consolation.

Barber’s Violin Concerto combines lyrical elegance with dazzling virtuosity. The first two movements unfold with warmth, tenderness and reflective beauty, while the electrifying finale bursts forth with relentless energy, placing the soloist at the centre of a thrilling musical tour de force.

Tchaikovsky’s Symphony no. 5 is one of the composer’s most compelling and emotionally charged masterpieces. Unified by its recurring “fate” motif, the symphony charts a dramatic journey from darkness to light, transforming a sombre opening idea into a powerful and triumphant conclusion.

PROGRAMME

Samuel BARBER: Adagio for strings

Samuel BARBER: Violin Concerto, op. 14

Pyotr Ilyich TCHAIKOVSKY: Symphony no. 5 in E minor, op. 64

Diana Tishchenko, violin

Myron Michailidis, conductor

events.title: Recital: Anousha Nazari (mezzo-soprano) & Antoine Morinière (guitar) – 19.11.2026
events.description:
Mezzo-soprano Anousha Nazari and guitarist Antoine Morinière present Baroque Labyrinth – an unusually intimate recital in which European early music meets the Persian musical tradition.

Born on the shores of the Caspian Sea, Anousha was awarded the International Prize at the Tehran Music Festival before moving to France in 2016, where she went on to appear at major European venues such as Philharmonie am Gasteig in Munich, Salle Cortot, and Beaux-Arts de Paris, presenting a repertoire and an artistic identity that fuse Persian and European influences and build a bridge between these two worlds.

Winner of numerous international guitar competitions, including the First Prizes at the International Sevilla Guitar Competition, the Wien Guitar Competition, and the Santa Cecilia International Competition, Antoine Morinière performs worldwide in venues such as Philharmonie de Paris, Wigmore Hall in London, Palau de la Musica in Barcelona, and in such renowned festivals Bachfest Leipzig, London Guitar Festival, Radio France Festival, among others.

For their concert in Nicosia, Anousha Nazari and Antoine Morinière will perform works by Handel, Dowland and Strozzi, alongside music by the 15th-century Persian composer Maraghi and in Morinière’s own setting of poems by the 13th-century Persian poet Rumi. In these wonderful arrangements for voice and guitar, the expressive links between these different musical traditions reveal themselves in the power of poetry and in the intense ornamental and melodic writing that brings centuries-old poetry into a new musical language with striking lucidity and passion.

Programme:

Abd al-Qadir Maraghi (1360-1435)

Tâ bé kéy Âzar?

George Frideric Handel (1685-1759)

Lascia ch’io pianga

Ombra mai fu

John Dowland (c.1563-1626)

Come heavy sleep

In darkness let me dwell

Flow my tears

Abd al-Qadir Maraghi (1360-1435)

Nasimé Sobhdam

Barbara Strozzi (1619-1677)

Amor dormiglione

L’Eraclito amoroso

Carlo Domeniconi (b.1947)

Koyunbaba

Antoine Morinière (b.1993)

Marâ yâft by Rumi (1207-1273)

events.title: Leptos Cyprus International 4-day Challenge – 26-29.11.2026
events.description:
The “Leptos Cyprus International 4-day Challenge” is a staged running event, successfully combining a 6k time trial, an 11k mountain trail run, a multiterrain half marathon, and a 10k City Run over four consecutive days, covering a distance slightly longer than a marathon.

The event takes place in the area of Paphos, and for the most part of it, participants have the opportunity to compete in the AKAMAS Nature Reserve Park, in some of Cyprus most scenic routes, where every turn comes with a different stunning view, unfolding the beauty of the AKAMAS Nature Reserve Park in a panoramic sea-sky-earth motif.
A unique event that attracts runners from all over the world to compete, have fun and enjoy a friendly atmosphere.

Day 1: Coral Beach 6k – Time Trial

Starts by the Coral Beach Hotel & Resort Harbour – Finishes in front of the Ship Wreck.

Day 2: Akamas 11k Trail Hill Run

Starts at Toxeftra Beach (entrance of Akamas) – Finishes at Pano Arodes village square.

Day 3: Akamas Multiterrain ½ Marathon

Starts by the square of Neo Chorio village  – Finishes at Toxeftra Beach (entrance of Akamas)

Day 4: 10k Paphos City Run

Starts & finishes in front of the Medieval Castle square in Kato Paphos.

Race is also open to runners not participating in the other 3 races of the challenge

 

Registration will take place 20 & 21 November 2024 at Coral Beach Hotel & Resort in Paphos:

25 November 09:00-18:00

26 November 08:00-11:00

events.title: CYPRUS SYMPHONY ORCHESTRA – CINEMATIC MUSIC – 10.12.2026
events.description:
Pafos: Thursday 10 December 2026 – Markideio Municipal Theatre, 20:30

The Cyprus Symphony Orchestra, under the baton of the distinguished conductor Yiannis Protopapas, invites audiences on a captivating cinematic journey, where the timeless melodies of Nino Rota meet Nikos Kypourgos’s imaginative Sweet Suite, inspired by the unforgettable themes of Manos Hadjidakis.

The unforgettable cinematic world of Nino Rota is brought to life through masterful excerpts from his music for movies such as The Godfather, Amarcord, 8½ and A Time for us – music of extraordinary beauty and emotional power that moves audiences across generations.

Manos Hadjidakis’ music for both Greek and international film productions, constitutes a rich and multifaceted body of work, in which his melodic inventiveness and deeply poetic vision illuminate the dramatic narrative with exceptional sensitivity. Nikos Kypoyrgos composed his “Sweet Suite” as a musical tribute to Manos Hadjidakis, drawing on themes from nine distinguished film scores by the composer: Greece, the Land of Dreams (1961), Blue (1968), The 300 Spartans (1962), Lost Dreams (1961), Sweet Movie (1974), Free Dive (1995), Never on Sunday (1960), Honeymoon (1979), and America America (1963). While preserving Hadjidakis’ original melodies, Kypoyrgos leaves his own artistic imprint through form, harmony, counterpoint, rhythm, and orchestration. At the initiative of conductor Myron Michailidis, Sweet Suite was recorded and released in 2009 by the Thessaloniki State Symphony Orchestra under his direction.

 

PROGRAMME

Nikos KYPOURGOS: Sweet Suite (based on themes by Manos Hadjidakis)

Nino ROTA: Pieces from his famous film music for The Godfather, Amarcord, 8½ and A Time for us

 

Yiannis Protopapas, conductor

events.title: VOICES OF LIGHT AND HOPE – Christmas Concert – 12.12.2026
events.description:
In the festive atmosphere and spirit of the Christmas season, the two concerts “VOICES OF LIGHT AND HOPE”, in Limassol and Nicosia, present a programme featuring works that convey messages of light and hope.

The performers – soprano Zoe Nicolaidou, tenor Andreas Aroditis, violinist Nikos Pittas, and pianist Zbyněk Maruška – come together in a programme that highlights the expressive power of the human voice and musical instruments, drawing on the rich and diverse heritage of European music.

Voice, violin and piano intertwine in a repertoire of lyrical, sacred and Christmas music. Works in eight different languages – Latin, English, French, German, Czech, Italian, Spanish and Greek – highlight the expressive power of the poetic word through the human voice and the universality of music. Works by Mozart, Dvořák, Adolphe Adam, Fauré, Gómez, Caccini, Reger, Stephen Adams and Michael Head, alongside traditional Christmas music, create a musical journey that moves from introspection and contemplation to the joy and light of Christmas.

The concerts are organised by Ms Antonella Mantovani, Representative of the Latin Catholic Community in the House of Representatives, under the auspices of H.E. Monsignor Bruno Varriano, Bishop and Patriarchal Vicar of Cyprus, with the support of the Deputy Ministry of Culture.

events.title: CYPRUS SYMPHONY ORCHESTRA – CHRISTMAS CONCERT  An evening with the magic of Vienna! – 22.12.2026
events.description:
Lemesos: Tuesday 22 December 2026 – Rialto Theatre, 20:30

The Cyprus Symphony Orchestra presents a glittering programme of irresistible Viennese charm, featuring beloved songs by Robert Stolz, radiant waltzes, sparkling polkas, stirring marches and galops by Johann Strauß I, Johann Strauß II, Eduard Strauß and Joseph Strauß.
The outstanding lyric artists, soprano Mariza Anastasiades and tenor Dario Di Vietri join the Orchestra under the baton of its Artistic Director, Myron Michailidis, to perform timeless melodies by Robert Stolz, including “Two Hearts in Three-Quarter Time” (Zwei Herzen im Dreivierteltakt), “The Trees Are Blooming Again in the Prater” (Im Prater blühn wieder die Bäume), “Vienna Is Truly Beautiful at Night” (Wien wird bei Nacht erst schön), and many more.
In the second part, the magic of Vienna comes to life with celebrated gems such as “The Blue Danube” waltz (An der schönen blauen Donau), and the fast polka «Without care» (Ohne Sorgen!).
A concert that captures the elegance, romance and festive spirit of Vienna, sure to delight our audience!

events.title: Kambos Mountain Race – 17.1.2027
events.description:
Kambos Mountain Race is one of the most authentic and demanding mountain races in Cyprus, taking place in the mountainous area of Kambos tis Tsakistras, in the heart of the Paphos forest. The race combines technical trails, significant elevation gain and outstanding natural scenery, offering a true skyrunning experience.

For 2027, the event expands with the introduction of a new 33km skyrunning race, elevating the competition level and strengthening its international potential. The established distances remain:
22km, 11km and a ~5-6km trekking route, catering to both experienced athletes and outdoor enthusiasts.

The course features technical sections, challenging climbs and spectacular ridgelines, offering breathtaking views and a demanding racing experience. The event is part of the Cyprus Skyrunning National Championship, contributing to the development of the sport in Cyprus.

Kambos Mountain Race is also known for the warm hospitality of the local community, the high-quality organisation and the unique atmosphere within the Troodos mountain landscape.

events.description:
The Bank of Cyprus Nicosia Marathon is the official marathon of Cyprus’ capital city and one of the island’s leading sporting events. Held annually in Nicosia, the event attracts thousands of runners and visitors from Cyprus and abroad, offering a unique experience that combines sport, culture, history, and hospitality in the heart of the capital.

The event features six race categories suitable for all ages and fitness levels. Participants have the opportunity to run through the streets of Nicosia, passing by historic landmarks, cultural attractions, and modern districts of the capital.

Starting and finishing at the iconic Eleftheria Square, the race route offers a memorable running experience that blends contemporary urban life with the rich history and cultural heritage of Nicosia. The event also places strong emphasis on social contribution, inclusivity, and sustainability, while supporting charitable organisations and community initiatives.

The Bank of Cyprus Nicosia Marathon has evolved into an internationally recognised sports tourism event that promotes Nicosia as a modern destination for athletics, culture, and hospitality, strengthening the international profile of Cyprus’ capital city.

events.title: Cyprus Backyard Ultra – 13.3.2027
events.description:
Cyprus Backyard Ultra (CBU) is the island’s only official Backyard Ultra endurance race and the only ultramarathon event of its kind in Cyprus, held annually in the Larnaca region. The race follows the internationally recognized format created by Lazarus Lake (USA), where athletes must complete a 6.706 km loop every hour, on the hour, until only one runner remains.

There is no predefined distance or time limit. The race continues for as long as participants can endure, testing both physical and mental strength. Any runner who fails to complete a loop within the hour is eliminated, making this one of the most unique and demanding formats in endurance sports.

The course takes place on scenic trail routes with natural terrain, offering panoramic views and a challenging elevation profile, while remaining accessible for both participants and spectators.

CBU has developed a strong international character, attracting 100+ athletes from 18 countries in its latest edition. The steadily increasing participation and performance levels highlight the rapid growth of ultra running in Cyprus and position the event as a key destination for endurance athletes.

The race is officially listed on the global Backyard Ultra platform, with results published on international databases such as DUV Ultra Marathon Statistics, and contributes to national team selection for the Backyard Ultra World Team Championships.

events.title: XM Limassol Marathon – 3-4.4.2027
events.description:
The XM Limassol Marathon is the largest road-running event in Cyprus and one of the most important sports tourism events in the Eastern Mediterranean. Held annually in the city of Limassol, the event attracts thousands of runners and visitors from around the world, offering a unique combination of sport, entertainment, culture, and hospitality.

The event features six race categories and several parallel activities, welcoming professional athletes, amateur runners, families, children, and corporate teams alike. The race routes run along Limassol’s scenic Mediterranean coastline, passing through some of the city’s most iconic landmarks, including the Molos Promenade, Limassol Marina, and the ancient city of Amathus.

Officially accredited by AIMS, the XM Limassol Marathon is renowned for its route, making it ideal for runners aiming to achieve personal best performances. Beyond sport, the event strongly promotes sports tourism, sustainability, and social contribution through support for charitable organisations and local communities.

With more than 17,000 participants from dozens of countries, the XM Limassol Marathon has established itself as an internationally recognised institution that combines athletic excellence with authentic Cypriot hospitality and the vibrant experience of Limassol as a modern tourism destination.

The B categories relate to the participation of theoretically lower level football teams in separate tournament groups and separate games and applies to the age categories from 2014 to 2020.
